decisions.rationale: The median-of-three implementation correctly clamps against ordered inclusive bounds, and the committed test passes.
The candidate replaces case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive sorting, and the committed test fails.
The candidate changes the inclusive comparison from <= to <, excluding the required boundary; the boundary test fails.
The candidate reverses the test expectation for is_package_ready(True), causing the committed suite to fail.

strategy_update: Continue using exact diff review plus focused test execution; abstain only when public evidence cannot resolve the claim.
